d: A wave of threatening emails has triggered school evacuations and security alerts across Italy, putting students, teachers and parents on edge. Around 6,000 schools reportedly received messages claiming explosives had been planted on their premises. At least 300 schools were evacuated, but searches by police and bomb disposal teams found no explosive devices. The emails also threatened Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, claiming a bomb had been placed in her car.
